text_blocks.original_text: PERFORO DIRECCIONAL CON BNA PDC 10 5/8" + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO REAMER 12 1/4" A LA PROFUNDIDAD DE 5712MTS A 5719 MTS (AMPLIANDO A 5691 MTS). CON PSB: 12-15 TON, 110-135 RPM, 14,000/16,500 FT-LB, 130 EPM, 500 GPM, 3900 PSI.
text_blocks.translated_text: DIRECTIONAL DRILLING WITH PDC BIT 10 5/8" + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO REAMER 12 1/4" AT DEPTH FROM 5712MTS TO 5719 MTS (REAMING TO 5691 MTS). WITH WOB: 12-15 TON, 110-135 RPM, 14,000/16,500 FT-LB, 130 EPM, 500 GPM, 3900 PSI.

text_blocks.original_text: NOTA1: PERFORANDO EL METRO 5717M, OBSERVO DISMINUCIÓN EN EL TIEMPO DE PENETRACIÓN DE 9 MIN POR METRO. POSTERIORMENTE PERFORO METRO A METRO DE 5717M HASTA 5719M LEVANTANDO SARTA POR SEGURIDAD LEVANTANDO LIBRE. PARÁMETROS CONTROLADOS DE TORQUE 17,000-19,000 FT-LB Y PSB: 5 TON.
text_blocks.translated_text: NOTE1: DRILLING METER 5717M, OBSERVED DECREASE IN PENETRATION TIME OF 9 MIN PER METER. SUBSEQUENTLY DRILLED METER BY METER FROM 5717M TO 5719M RAISING STRING FOR SAFETY RAISING FREE. CONTROLLED PARAMETERS TORQUE 17,000-19,000 FT-LB AND WOB: 5 TON.

text_blocks.original_text: NOTA2: OBSERVO RESISTENCIA PARA REGRESAR AL FONDO DESDE 5718.6 HASTA 5719M CON TORQUE DE 17,000 - 19,000 FT-LB.
text_blocks.translated_text: NOTE2: OBSERVED RESISTANCE TO RETURN TO BOTTOM FROM 5718.6 TO 5719M WITH TORQUE OF 17,000 - 19,000 FT-LB.

text_blocks.original_text: NOTA3: DECIDIO LEVANTAR SARTA A 5690M PARA RECUPERAR MUESTRA DE FONDO Y CARACTERIZAR CON GEOLOGÍA.
text_blocks.translated_text: NOTE3: DECIDED TO RAISE STRING TO 5690M TO RECOVER BOTTOM SAMPLE AND CHARACTERIZE WITH GEOLOGY.

text_blocks.original_text: LEVANTO SARTA Y BARRENA DE 10 5/8" A DE 5,719 A 5,692 M PARA CIRCULAR POZO Y RECUPERAR MUESTRA DE FONDO Y CARACTERIZAR POR GEOLOGÍA.
text_blocks.translated_text: RAISED STRING AND BIT 10 5/8" FROM 5,719 TO 5,692 M TO CIRCULATE WELL AND RECOVER BOTTOM SAMPLE AND CHARACTERIZE BY GEOLOGY.

text_blocks.original_text: PERFORO DIRECCIONAL CON BNA PDC 10 5/8" + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO REAMER 12 1/4" DESDE 5,719 MTS HASTA 5752 MTS (AMPLIANDO A 5724 MTS). CON PSB: 6-10 TON, 130 RPM, 14,000/16,500 FT-LB, 130 EPM, 500 GPM, 4000 PSI.
text_blocks.translated_text: DIRECTIONAL DRILLING WITH PDC BIT 10 5/8" + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO REAMER 12 1/4" FROM 5,719 MTS TO 5752 MTS (REAMING TO 5724 MTS). WITH WOB: 6-10 TON, 130 RPM, 14,000/16,500 FT-LB, 130 EPM, 500 GPM, 4000 PSI.

text_blocks.original_text: RECORD BNA: 352 M EN 166:00 HRS. RHINO: 318 M EN 144:44 HRS. ULT.3.MTS: 36' - 32' - 44'. PROM: 32.78 MIN/M.
text_blocks.translated_text: BIT RECORD: 352 M IN 166:00 HRS. RHINO: 318 M IN 144:44 HRS. LAST 3.MTS: 36' - 32' - 44'. AVG: 32.78 MIN/M.

text_blocks.original_text: NOTA: INCREMENTO DENSIDAD DE LODO DE 2.0 GR/CC A 2.02 GR/CC.
text_blocks.translated_text: NOTE: INCREASED MUD DENSITY FROM 2.0 GR/CC TO 2.02 GR/CC.

text_blocks.original_text: NOTA1: LEVANTO CON CIRCULACION Y SIN ROTACION A 5,712 M PARA VERIFICAR PESOS, LIBRE. PESOS DE SARTA: ESTATICO 206 TON, ARRIBA 222 TON, TQ FUERA DE FONDO 13,500 FT-LB.
text_blocks.translated_text: NOTE1: RAISED WITH CIRCULATION AND WITHOUT ROTATION TO 5,712 M TO VERIFY WEIGHTS, FREE. STRING WEIGHTS: STATIC 206 TON, UP 222 TON, TQ OFF BOTTOM 13,500 FT-LB.

text_blocks.original_text: NOTA2: SUSPENDE POR OBTENER 100 HRS CONTINUAS DE PERFORACION PARA REALIZAR VIAJE DE CORTO DE ACUERDO A PROGRAMA.
text_blocks.translated_text: NOTE2: SUSPENDED FOR OBTAINING 100 CONTINUOUS HOURS OF DRILLING TO PERFORM SHORT TRIP ACCORDING TO PROGRAM.

text_blocks.original_text: NOTA3: OBSERVO PERDIDA DE SENAL DE LA HTTA MWD A 5752M. REALIZO PRUEBA ANTIJAMMING RECUPERANDO SENAL DE LAS HERRAMIENTAS (MWD) SATISFACTORIAMENTE.
text_blocks.translated_text: NOTE3: OBSERVED LOSS OF SIGNAL FROM HTTA MWD AT 5752M. PERFORMED ANTIJAMMING TEST RECOVERING TOOL SIGNAL (MWD) SATISFACTORILY.

text_blocks.original_text: LODO PERDIDO DIA: 0 M3. ACUMULADO ETAPA: 527:4 M3. UNIDADES DE GAS: 10
text_blocks.translated_text: MUD LOST DAY: 0 M3. ACCUMULATED STAGE: 527.4 M3. GAS UNITS: 10

text_blocks.original_text: MANTIENE EN EL SISTEMA CIRCULANTE 15 KG/M3 DE CACO 3 M-200 Y 2 LT/M3 DE VERSACOAT.
text_blocks.translated_text: MAINTAINS IN CIRCULATING SYSTEM 15 KG/M3 OF CACO 3 M-200 AND 2 LT/M3 OF VERSACOAT.

text_blocks.original_text: 5740 M: 100% HALITA BLANCA CON TRAZAS DE LUTITA GRIS OSCURO, SEMIDURA A DURA LIGERAMENTE CALCAREO.
text_blocks.translated_text: 5740 M: 100% WHITE HALITE WITH TRACES OF DARK GRAY SHALE, SEMI-HARD TO HARD SLIGHTLY CALCAREOUS.

text_blocks.original_text: Resumen: PERFORO CON BNA PDC 10 5/8" + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO REAMER 12 1/4" A LA PROFUNDIDAD DE 5752 MTS (AMPLIANDO A 5724 MTS).
text_blocks.translated_text: Summary: DRILLED WITH PDC BIT 10 5/8" + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO REAMER 12 1/4" TO DEPTH OF 5752 MTS (REAMING TO 5724 MTS).

text_blocks.original_text: SGTE. OPERACIÓN: PERFORAR DIRECCIONALMENTE CON BNA PDC 10 5/8" + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO 12 1/4" HASTA LA PROFUNDIDAD DE 6165 MTS.
text_blocks.translated_text: NEXT OPERATION: DRILL DIRECTIONALLY WITH PDC BIT 10 5/8" + PD + HTTA MWD + RHINO 12 1/4" TO DEPTH OF 6165 MTS.
